text:
maya: noticed invoice preview spike for 12 tenants after the midnight deploy. token totals match, but extra SKU lines appeared for 'priority-route' with tiny token counts.
rakesh: spike as in how big?
maya: very small absolute tokens, but appeared across many orgs so preview sums differ from ledger by ~0.9%.
abby: did sampling change? the proxy has that new sample_flag propagation patch (PR 4552).
maya: sample_flag shows true in router logs but transformer sees sample=false for the same request ids.
ramsh: sorry typo, @rakesh.
rakesh: can you paste log snippet?
maya: ```WARN routing-proxy: sample_flag mismatch req=rid_f3e2 proxy.sample=true downstream.sample=false payload={"tenant":"zenco","req_id":"rid_f3e2","tokens":12}```
tam: that implies the proxy header isn't being mapped to the internal 'sampled' field consumed by metering. If sampled flips, dedupe and sampling-weighting paths diverge, so some events get full attribution.
abby: interesting: our sampling path marks sampled=true -> produces event with sample_weight=0.01 and route_tag=priority. if it flips, we emit weight=1.0. that would create those extra SKU lines.
metering-bot: alert: sampling-inconsistency-rate 182 events in 5m for service=ingest-proxy
rakesh: how long since deploy? midnight -> 00:05 saw first. which image? proxy v2.10.0.
maya: yes, v2.10.0 includes the header-copy refactor. I can roll back to v2.9.4 but that drops a security header fix.
tam: could we patch mapping instead? quick fix in converter that honors X-Proxy-Sampled header into event.sampled. minimal risk.
abby: agree patch converter, deploy canary to 5% tenants, watch metering.sampling_consistency and invoice-preview-delta metric.
maya: also need console visibility: add a small card under metering-health showing 'sampling_consistency_ratio' over 1h and 5m windows. put an orange alert at 0.5% for 5m.
console-bot: ticket created: METR-3124 add sampling_consistency_ratio panel and alert.
rakesh: for backfill: events that already had wrong sample weight will have different ledger hashes (sample_weight included), so replays might appear as duplicates. We should prefer idempotent replay path that preserves original event_signature. Do we still persist raw-kafka payloads?
maya: yes raw-kafka-archive exists for 7 days. we can re-run converter -> transformer with correct mapping. but ledger dedupe uses signature sha256(event_id + sample_weight + route_tag). If we replay with corrected sample_weight, hashes won't match the 'incorrect' entries that already landed.
abby: but invoices are built from aggregate SKU lines, not per-event ledger claims. If we re-ingest corrected events and mark old claims as 'stale' using a tombstone process, aggregate sums will reflect corrected SKU attribution. tombstoning is slower and messier.
tam: alternative: compute delta per tenant by comparing archive-reprocessed counts vs current ledger and submit corrective adjustments for invoice-preview only. don't mutate ledger.
rakesh: that sounds safer legally. Keep ledger append-only, produce invoice-adjustment entries flagged as audit-only. We'll need buy-in from finance.
maya: I'll draft a short runbook for METR-3124: detection -> patch converter -> canary 5% -> reprocess archive for 00:00..00:10 -> compute per-tenant adjustments -> push invoice-preview corrections -> monitor 24h.
abby: add a test for the sample flag mapping in integration suite so PRs can't drop it again.
maya: will open a CI test PR. also capturing 10 example req ids to incidents channel for audit.
console-bot: canary deploy started: converter-service v1.4.5->v1.4.6-canary(5%)
metering-bot: archive-replay queued: archive-replay-20260313-0000-0010 (est 30m)
rakesh: ping finance for approval on non-ledger invoice adjustments, tag @jen-finance.
maya: tagged. thanks. I'll update here as each step completes. :thumbsup:
